description: IST02-IST03 JSE-Eskom Infrastructure-Coupled Financial Network Dataset METRIC: Trophic Cascade Governance of Resource-Constrained Layered Hypergraphs — Derived Dataset and Replication Code HK-DeepIV: Analysis Code and Su is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ntebogang Dinah Moroke (North-West University, South Africa). Hypergraph edge-weight time series linking 87 JSE-listed securities to 34 Eskom transmission grid nodes (January 2015 to December 2025, T=2870 trading days, 340 hyperedges). Supports IST-02 CASCADEnt/VORTEX and IST-03 PHYSAN research series by Prof. N.D. Moroke, North-West University, South Africa. Coverage: national (ZA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
